name: run_test_verification
description: Mint a synthetic staging World ID 4.0 verification payload for your backend. Only the chain verdict is simulated. direct=true tests portal configuration only. Supported outcomes: success, expired, invalid_proof; invalid_rp_signature and below_sybil_threshold await verified mappings.

name: get_team_context
description: Fetch the Dev Portal team and app context for this API key.

name: get_app_config
description: Fetch app, World ID, Mini App, and app store configuration.

name: create_app
description: Create a production external World ID app or Mini App.

name: configure_world_id
description: Create a managed World ID 4.0 RP for an app. The platform creates a KMS-backed manager key, submits the on-chain registration transaction, and (on production) duplicates to the staging contract. A new signer wallet is generated server-side; its private key is returned ONCE in the response — the portal does not retain it.

signer_private_key.description: Optional. If provided, the resulting wallet's address is registered as the on-chain signer. If omitted, a fresh wallet is generated server-side and the private key is returned once.

name: get_world_id_signing_key
description: Fetch signer address. Private keys are only returned on MCP generation/rotation.

name: get_world_id_registration_status
description: Fetch and sync World ID RP registration status from the registry contracts for an app.

name: rotate_world_id_signing_key
description: Generate or set a new World ID signing key for an app.

name: create_world_id_action
description: Create or update a World ID 4.0 action for an app.

name: configure_mini_app
description: Update Mini App portal settings, app store metadata, and Advanced/Permissions configuration (contracts, permit2 tokens, notification limits, etc.).

description.description: Stored verbatim. Prefer description_overview for the human-readable text shown in the app store; the server will JSON-encode it for you.

description_overview.description: App store overview shown to users. Required for review submission. Server JSON-encodes this (with description_how_it_works / description_connect) into app_metadata.description.

whitelisted_addresses.description: Wallet addresses allowed to interact with the mini app. Pass an empty array to disable the whitelist.

max_notifications_per_day.description: How many notifications the mini app may send per day. Pass "unlimited" for no cap (automatically sets is_allowed_unlimited_notifications: true).

name: upload_app_image
description: Upload an app image (logo, hero, content_card, meta_tag, showcase_1/2/3) from a public HTTPS source URL or base64 data and set the corresponding app_metadata field. Image must be PNG or JPEG, ≤500KB. Required for app store submissions which gate on logo_img_url and (for Mini Apps) content_card_image_url.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS URL the server fetches. Must resolve to a public address (loopback/private/link-local rejected). Redirects are not followed. Use this OR image_base64.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded PNG/JPEG bytes. Use this OR source_url. The server detects the format from magic bytes; no separate content_type input is needed.

name: submit_app_for_review
description: Submit an app for review after explicit confirmation from the user.
